mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuations and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or average returns are negative when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates severe economic contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return pattern fails when both INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises (positive returns in >60% of instances) or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods, 20-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% instances or correlation between CPIAUCSL and returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates stronger consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or average returns are negative when HOUST is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO < 100.0 instances or correlation between INDPRO and returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) generates immediate positive market reactions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or average returns are negative when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return pattern fails when both RSAFS and HOUST increase (positive returns in <=40% of instances) or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
